title: LIST: October 2026 special non-working days in PH provinces, cities, towns
summary: Here are the October 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President

blocks.text: Here are the October 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President
MANILA, Philippines – This is a compilation of special non-working days in various localities in the Philippines for October 2026, as proclaimed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

items: October 1 – Aborlan, Palawan, via Proclamation No. 1452 s. 2026
October 2 – Solano, Nueva Vizcaya, via Proclamation No. 1453 s. 2026
October 2 – Dinagat Islands, via Proclamation No. 1440 s. 2026
October 5 – Del Gallego, Camarines Sur, via Proclamation No. 1441 s. 2026
October 7 – Guipos, Zamboanga del Sur, via Proclamation No. 1442 s. 2026
October 8 – Koronadal, South Cotabato, via Proclamation No. 1443 s. 2026
